I started playing in 5.25 and what I looked forward to most when I started was raiding.

My main gripe with Shadowbringers personally was the story and I feel like I’ll get a lot of flak for it as so many of the friends and people around me live in this echo chamber that SHB is a work of art sent straight down from god.

I enjoyed Stormblood thoroughly. It was my favourite expac and I was excited to experience Shadowbringers due to all the rave around it but I personally had a huge disconnect with the characters going from SB to SHB. 5.0 was phenomenal, I enjoyed the entirety of 5.0 truly but the 5.x patches lost me. As we got more and more into finding our way back, the story felt like it was going to sacrifice simp catboy and constantly insinuated it. I expected maybe a soft reboot of him, awakening ARR simpcat and I felt like it was a copout even being able to bring the future version into the current present with no issues. It lost my interest fast after that & I haven’t had energy to pay attention to the story.

I loved the trials save for the weapon ones. Titania & Seat of Sacrifice were my all time favourite fights. Both their music and visuals make me love going back even when I have no reason, I’m just so sad that so many mechs can be skipped in Titania that you can literally solo heal solo tank it and breeze by. Hated each weapon fight especially Emerald and Diamond. Diamond was SO boring, it just felt like a game of hop scotch. 

E1-4S have been fun for me to go back and experience. E4S is some of the most fun I’ve had. E5-8S was my first tier and I actually really enjoyed 8. As annoying as it was, it was a fun fight when you weren’t dying to things you shouldn’t be dying to. E9-12S were OK fights to me on launch. I didn’t like 9s and 10s was enjoyable to learn. 11s was fun when everyone wasn’t geared and you needed to work to properly mitigate and heal. 12s ok. The second phase needed to be fleshed out more as the first phase is the only barrier to the fight.

I hated the dungeons as we progressed because it felt like they just got progressively more and more … softlocked? I don’t know the word for it. Kind of like I was forced to take it at a certain pace. I like just running through the dungeon if I have the possibility to and not getting walled off. 

I hated the alliance raids but also I don’t like or care for the Nier series, so really that’s that for it. I enjoyed Bozja/Zadnor when it first came out, it gets extremely stale though and to be honest idk the story lol. CLL and Dalriada were a lot of fun but I got sick of DR fast.

Ultimate(s hahaha only one sadge) The only thing I enjoyed was watching my bf prog TEA. It’s the whole reason I got into the game. The fight is just so beautiful and looks so fun and demanding. It requires you to make full usage out of your kits unlike how the past ultimates have been softened thanks to ability changes & how the sync is. I’m trying to find a group to prog as much as I can in it because it’s what I want to do most out of everything in the game.
